info.title: genie API
info.description: API for the genie social-gifting platform. Implemented: auth, catalog, merchant products, events, wishlists, wallet funding (mock), gifting (wallet + bank transfer), anonymous gifts + reveal, fees & commission, saved cards, merchant orders & delivery, payouts & withdrawals, friends & contact matching, notifications & push device tokens, referrals & rewards, activity feed, KYC Level 1 (mock bureau), profile & session management, account deletion, support threads. Other endpoints are documented but return 501.
